# Clarvix

> Clarvix finds and prioritizes revenue leaks for Israeli SMBs and clinics: broken conversion tracking, wasted ad spend, and funnel/attribution gaps across Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, Search Console, and Google Tag Manager. Read-only by default — nothing changes on a client's ad accounts or analytics without their explicit approval.

## Service tiers

- Public Revenue Leak Scan: free, no-credentials automated scan of a business's public ad and site signals.
- Revenue Leak Verify Lite: one-time paid, read-only verification against a client's own GA4/Search Console/Tag Manager.
- Revenue Leak Monitor: recurring monthly monitoring with alerts and prioritized fix proposals.
- AdTech Control Tower: recurring monthly executive briefs plus a human-approved implementation backlog.
